/**
 * Billing tiers — the plans this app sells.
 *
 * Paid tiers take their `stripePriceId` from env vars so the same code
 * serves test-mode and live Stripe prices per environment. Create prices in
 * the Stripe Dashboard (Products > Add price) and paste the price_... IDs
 * into the API .env (see STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY / STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_YEARLY
 * there). GET /api/billing/tiers serves this table to the app pricing page;
 * POST /api/billing/checkout rejects any priceId not listed here.
 *
 * Add/rename tiers freely — ids are stable keys other code (entitlements,
 * plan badges) references. Prices are in the smallest currency unit (cents).
 */
import { defineTiers } from '@molecule/api-billing-routes'

export const tiers = defineTiers([
  { id: 'free', name: 'Free', features: ['Get started'], priceMonthly: 0 },
  {
    id: 'pro_monthly',
    name: 'Pro (Monthly)',
    features: ['Everything in Free', 'Priority support'],
    priceMonthly: 1200,
    stripePriceId: process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY,
  },
  {
    id: 'pro_yearly',
    name: 'Pro (Yearly)',
    features: ['Everything in Free', 'Priority support', 'Two months free'],
    priceYearly: 12000,
    stripePriceId: process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_YEARLY,
  },
])

secrets.name: FLY_SANDBOX_EGRESS_ALLOWED_PORTS
secrets.label: Sandbox egress allow-list (protocol:port)
secrets.instructions: Comma-separated protocol:port pairs a sandbox may open outbound connections on. Setting it makes the provider apply a Fly network policy to every sandbox app, after which Fly drops all other egress. Unset means NO egress restriction and verifyEgress() will report `open`. Fly matches protocol and port only — there is no host or CIDR matching — so allow only the port of an egress proxy you control if you need a host allow-list. Ports declared in FLY_SANDBOX_PRIVATE_SERVICES are added automatically — do not widen this list by hand.

secrets.name: FLY_SANDBOX_PRIVATE_SERVICES
secrets.label: Cross-6PN services (app:port)
secrets.instructions: Comma-separated <fly-app>:<port> pairs every sandbox must reach across its per-project 6PN — typically the tenant Postgres cluster and the control plane's egress proxy. The provider allocates a Flycast private address on each app INTO the project's own network at boot and releases it on destroy; the sandbox then dials <app>.flycast:<port>. Without this, a project with a database DOES NOT WORK on Fly: apps on separate 6PNs cannot communicate. Each target app needs an [http_service] or [services] section and must bind 0.0.0.0. The declared port is added to the egress network policy automatically.
